description: #272/#284: the output size a canvas-sourced turn sends, for Offerings of the default Product Schema; #296: cases with source 'reference' are a chat edit of one uploaded picture of width x height with no size chosen. Read by TestCanvasTurnSizesSharedWithTheWebClient (Go, canvasSizeChoice + forced values + the size note) and by src/lib/workspace/canvas-size.test.ts (canvasTurnOutput / referenceTurnOutput, which drive the size notices), so both sides must agree. 'nearest' is true when the size note uses the nearest-size template: for the canvas, any size other than the canvas size or a larger one of its shape; for a reference, any size of another shape.
